q_uz: 2025 yilda paxta jami qancha tonna sotilgan (bekor qilinganlarsiz)?
q_ru: Сколько тонн хлопка продано в 2025 (без аннулированных)?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, round(sum(volume_t),1) AS tonnes FROM deals WHERE family_key='cotton' AND year=2025 AND NOT is_annulled

q_uz: 2025 yilda AI-92 benzinning litr uchun o‘rtacha narxi?
q_ru: Средняя цена АИ-92 за литр в 2025?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_annulled) AS n_annulled, round(wavg_price(amount, volume),2) AS price FROM deals WHERE product_key='petrol' AND brand='АИ-92' AND unit='литр' AND year=2025

q_uz: 2024 yilda sement bo‘yicha eng katta xaridor (summa bo‘yicha)?
q_ru: Крупнейший покупатель цемента в 2024 по сумме?
sql: SELECT buyer_name, buyer_inn, count(*) AS n_deals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_annulled) AS n_annulled, sum(amount_uzs) AS total_uzs, sum(amount_uzs) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_annulled) AS total_uzs_valid FROM deals WHERE product_key='cement' AND year=2024 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY total_uzs DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE is_annulled
SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE year=2026 AND month=10

q_ru: Общая сумма экспортных сделок в долларах?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, sum(amount) AS total_usd FROM deals WHERE is_export

q_uz: Eksport bitimlarining jami summasi so‘mda (bitim kunidagi kurs bilan)?
q_ru: Сумма экспортных сделок в сумах по курсу на дату сделки?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, sum(amount_uzs) AS total_uzs FROM deals WHERE is_export

q_ru: Сколько сделок в городе Ташкенте в 2023?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE region_id='TAS' AND year=2023

q_uz: Eng ko‘p bitim tuzgan sotuvchi broker?
q_ru: Брокер продавца с наибольшим числом сделок?
sql: SELECT seller_broker, seller_broker_name, count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n_deals DESC LIMIT 1

q_uz: Kechikib yetkazilgan bitimlar soni va o‘rtacha kechikish?
q_ru: Сколько поставок с опозданием и средняя просрочка?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, round(avg(delivery_delay_days),1) AS avg_days FROM deals WHERE is_delivery_late

q_uz: Muddati o‘tgan, to‘lanmagan ochiq bitimlar nechta?
q_ru: Сколько открытых сделок с просроченной оплатой?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE is_open AND pay_date IS NULL AND pay_due_date < DATE '2026-10-30'

q_uz: 2025 yilda qayta ishlash korxonalari qancha bug‘doy sotib olgan (tonna)?
q_ru: Сколько пшеницы (т) купили перерабатывающие предприятия в 2025?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_annulled) AS n_annulled, round(sum(volume_t)) AS tonnes, round(sum(volume_t) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_annulled)) AS tonnes_valid FROM deals WHERE product_key='wheat' AND year=2025 AND buyer_activity_ru='Перерабатывающее предприятие'

q_uz: Dizel yoqilg‘isi 2026 yilda tonnada o‘rtacha narxi?
q_ru: Средняя цена дизтоплива за тонну в 2026?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_annulled) AS n_annulled, round(wavg_price(amount, volume)) AS price_per_t FROM deals WHERE product_key='diesel' AND unit='тонна' AND year=2026

q_ru: Сколько спот-сделок по хлопку 1 сорт 2 класс?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE product_key='cotton_spot' AND grade_sort='1' AND grade_class=2
SELECT deal_no, deal_date, product_ru, amount_uzs, currency, seller_name, buyer_name FROM deals ORDER BY amount_uzs DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE year=2026 AND month=11
SELECT count(*) AS n_deals FROM deals WHERE family_key='sugar' AND is_export
